# spoti.pw v0.22.0

**Released September 23, 2026**

This release contains the **spoti.pw v0.22.0 IPA builds** based on the upstream project.

> ⚠️ **Important:** v0.21.1 is the **last spoti.pw release to include Spoof Premium and Hide Ads**. These features are not available in newer releases, so users who specifically want them should use v0.21.1.

> Important: spoti.pw is a UI tweak for Spotify on iOS. Sign the resulting build with your own certificate.

## Downloads

### Spotify Tweaked

**spoti.pw-v0.22.0.ipa**

Built using the updated spoti.pw v0.22.0 changes.

---

### Spotify Decrypted

**Spotify-Decrypted.ipa**

This is the same decrypted Spotify IPA carried forward from the previous v0.21.1 release.

---

### Spotify Tweaks `.deb`

**com.spotipw_0.22.0_iphoneos-arm.deb**

**SHA-256:** `b45c34760aa082d504b8706a5a766613ed837b5ecdb00329ac6efce910403547`

## What's Included

This build is based on **spoti.pw v0.22.0**, which includes:

* Apple Music-style animated album artwork on the lock screen when a track has no Canvas
* Canvas playback as animated lock-screen artwork
* Audio effects running on the mod's own engine; libjamesdsp has been removed
* Glass search bar for finding tracks in playlists when pulling down
* Genius lyric line meanings with artist-owned lines shown differently
* Mod > Licenses now shows the mod license and full third-party licenses
* Follow now uses the same glyph/checkmark behavior as Add to Library
* Fixes for long settings notes being truncated
* Fixes for Add to Library and Follow state behavior
* Player menu and lyrics loading fixes
* Playlist cover sizing and fade fixes while pulling down
* Fix for the redesigned player being able to scroll upward

For the complete upstream changelog, see the [[v0.22.0 upstream release](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw/releases/tag/v0.22.0)](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw/releases/tag/v0.22.0).

## Installation

The IPA is **unsigned** and must be signed before installation.

Compatible signing methods include:

* **SideStore**
* **AltStore**
* **Feather**
* **Sideloadly**
* Other compatible IPA signing tools

Your signing certificate and provisioning profile are your responsibility.

## Important

* This project is **not affiliated with Spotify**.
* Installation and signing are performed at your own risk.

## Credits

Built from the upstream [[skopevoj/spoti.pw](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw)](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw) project.

All original development and source-code changes belong to the upstream project and its contributors.

This repository primarily provides **built IPA releases**.

---

### Support the upstream project

If you enjoy spoti.pw, consider supporting the developers through Ko-fi.

**Upstream:** [[github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw)](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw)

**License:** GPL-3.0
